consensus_summary: Wheat primarily symbolizes the true believers or children of the kingdom (the righteous/elect) who are gathered into God's barn at the eschatological harvest/judgment, as distinguished from tares or chaff.
book_summary: The children of the kingdom — the good grain gathered into the barn at the harvest.
consensus_core_identification: children of the kingdom / true believers / righteous gathered at final harvest
book_core_identification: children of the kingdom (good grain) gathered into the barn at the harvest
rationale: Minimum cores are identical in referent, category, and harvest context; wording differences are immaterial. Consensus alternatives (e.g., John 12:24 grain-of-wheat, provision/bread) are secondary uses and do not alter the shared primary identification drawn from the same texts.
strongest_objection: None material; book simply omits secondary senses that consensus itself treats as non-primary.
